significance: A Paadal Petra Sthalam near Thiruvaiyaru revered in the Tevaram and counted among the eight Ashta Veeratanam temples marking Shiva's heroic deeds — here the severing of Brahma's fifth head; unusually, the complex contains a separate shrine to Brahma. Inscriptions record Chola, Thanjavur Nayak and Maratha patronage.
story: Shiva plucked off Brahma's fifth head at this place and was himself freed of the resulting sin after bathing in the temple's Kamala Pushkarani tank.
